title: Sticky Commits sticker
description: Your sticker for the class wall. Generated from assets/js/schema.js — run `npm run schema` after changing the rules.

name.description: The big name on your sticker.

title.description: A short tagline under your name.

github.description: Your GitHub username (defaults to your folder name).

image.description: A picture file in your folder (e.g. "photo.png"), a https:// link, or "none" for emoji-only. Leave it out to use your GitHub avatar.

imageFit.description: "cover" fills the frame, "contain" shows the whole picture.

imagePosition.description: Which part of the picture to focus on.

emoji.description: A little emoji badge (or your whole picture when image is "none").

shape.description:
classic: Rounded sticker with a photo window
polaroid: Instant photo with a handwritten caption
badge: Round badge — your name curves around the edge
ticket: Admit-one ticket with punched notches
blob: Wobbly jelly blob that slowly morphs
cutout: Die-cut around your picture (best with transparent PNGs)

finish.description:
matte: Soft paper, no shine
glossy: Shiny, catches the light
holo: Rainbow holographic foil
glitter: Sparkly glitter that twinkles

font.description: One of the preset fonts, or any Google Fonts name.

colors.description: Any CSS colours — background can also be a gradient.

background.description: Background colour or gradient, e.g. "#ffd6ec" or "linear-gradient(160deg, #ffb17a, #ff6fae)".

accent.description: Accent colour: badge ring, labels, pin and tape.

name.description: A different colour just for your name (optional).

attach.description: How your sticker is stuck to the wall.

tilt.description: Rotation in degrees. Leave it out for a random tilt.

about.description: Text on the back of your sticker.

facts.description: Up to 3 fun facts for the back.

css.description: Your own CSS file in your folder, e.g. "style.css".
